profile.headline: Kafka @ New Relic

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Supply Chain Fulfillment Services
positions.description:
♦ Focused on writing well documented and well tested Java11 code. Finds creative solutions for complex software problems. Strong advocate for the KISS and SOLID software development principles. 

♦ Created stateless Java8 application that transfers warehouse events to Kafka topic with (near) exactly-once delivery semantics. Uses Spring Boot 2.1.x and Spring Framework 5.1.x. Built with distroless Docker containers and deployed into AWS Kubernetes cluster via automated CI/CD pipe.

♦ Member of the customer advisory board for the Kubernetes platform team and Gitlab CI/CD team. Responsible for sharing platform announcements and ensure our respective teams adhere to standards.

♦ Built stand-alone secure Sonar instance, deployed on Kubernetes, so that teams may perform static analysis as well as mutation testing in a private environment with admin privileges.

positions.title: Founder & Leather Crafter
positions.description:
♦ Over 2,300 orders shipped world-wide

♦ Personally handmade each and every leather piece during evenings and weekends

♦ Managed several e-commerce platform and marketing campaigns

♦ Regularly tracked assets and liabilities. Created system to reliably generate income, profit/loss statements

positions.title: Member
positions.description:
Worked with the Tijuana River Estuary to increase production efficiency
Analyzed the benefits of a photovoltaic system to support a warehouse facility
Delivered classroom talks to encourage young students to pursue science and engineering

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Tested the company's mobile application. The application's intended use was for business executives to easily and effectively publish data to their company's employees. The application creatively displays data in which it can publish to a network at the press of a button.

positions.title: Software Engineer Assistant
positions.description: Helped the company expand their production line by adding more computer units to the network. Assisted the primary software engineer in debugging software defects. Logging defects in the company's Bugzilla database. Assisted in network administration and helped solve server issues.
